President Vladimir Putin says Russia's first wartime parliamentary election was a sign
of public support for his policies. Election officials say the main Kremlin party, United
Russia, will get a record more than three-fourths of the seats in the state Duma. The tightly-orchestrated
vote excluded virtually any genuine opposition. Putin said the vote "shows that the people
of Russia support our efforts."
Harvey Weinstein's New York sex crimes case came to a close this morning when the former

Harvey Weinstein was first convicted of sex crimes in New York in 2020, and sentenced
to 23 years in prison. But that was thrown out. Prosecutors have since brought him back
to court multiple times. Last year, Weinstein was found guilty of sexually assaulting Miriam
Haley in 2006 when she was a production assistant. The 15-year sentence is from that conviction.
Weinstein was found not guilty on another charge, and two separate juries in New York

An FDA panel has endorsed an experimental cancer test that uses a blood sample to detect
multiple forms of the disease. The vote could pave the way for broader adoption and insurance
coverage of the test from manufacturer Grail, Inc. The company's test is part of a new field
of tests aiming to catch cancer in people who otherwise appear healthy. This is NPR News.
